rules.name: Azure AD Suspicious Sign-in
rules.description: Detects suspicious sign-in activity in Azure AD
rules.rule_code:
def rule(event):
    risk_level = event.get('riskLevelDuringSignIn', '').lower()
    return risk_level in ['high', 'medium']

def title(event):
    user = event.get('userPrincipalName', 'unknown')
    risk = event.get('riskLevelDuringSignIn', 'unknown')
    return f"Suspicious Azure AD sign-in by {user} - Risk: {risk}"
